questions.question: The Code of Criminal Procedure was enacted in year _______ in India.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1973.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC)** is a procedural law that **governs the process of investigation** and** trial of criminal cases** in India.
 
• The CrPC was **enacted in 1973** and came **into force on April 1, 1974.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Following the Indian uprising of 1857, the** British** crown assumed control of the country, and **in 1861 the Criminal Procedure Code was passed**.
 
• The legacy of British India lasted until 1973, when the present Code was passed and went into effect on April 1st, 1974.
 
• The **main objective** of the CrPC is **to ensure a fair and just investigation and trial of criminal cases**, while also **protecting the rights of the accused and the victims.**
 
• It offers the tools necessary for conducting criminal investigations, apprehending suspected offenders, gathering evidence, establishing the guilt or innocence of the accused, and determining the appropriate punishment for the guilty.
 
• In addition, it addresses maintaining a spouse, child, and parents as well as preventing offenses and public nuisances.
 
• **The Code of Criminal Procedure** is divided into** 37 chapters** with **484 sections, 2 schedules,** and **56 forms.**
 
• A Bill to replace the CrPC with the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) was presented in the Lok Sabha on August 11, 2023.

questions.question: In the Tamil region, landless labourers, including slaves, were known as _____ during Sangam age.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kadaisiyar and Adimai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Slaves and landless labourers **in the Tamil region during the **Sangam era** were referred to as "**kadaisiyar and adimai**."
 
• People who **had to work extremely hard to survive **at the** bottom of the social hierarchy** were referred to as "**kadaisiyar**."
 
• **Slaves** who were **owned by landlords** and compelled to work for them were known as "**adimai**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Sangam Age**, sometimes referred to as the** Tamil Sangam period**, was an important period in South India's history. It is generally believed that the Sangam era occurred **between 300 BCE and 300 CE**.
 
• **Three dynasties—the Chera, Chola, and Pandyas**—ruled the Tamil nation during the Sangam Period. They were **Muvendar**, jointly as well.
 
• For administrative convenience, the **kingdom was split **into the following **divisions: Mandalam (territory), Nadu (province), Ur (town), Perur (large village), and Sirur (small village).**
 
• **More terms used in sangam age**:
 
 
• Karai: Land tax

questions.question: Two boats A and B start moving towards each other from two places, 272 km apart. The speed of the boat A and B in still water are 32 km/h and 36 km/h, respectively. If A moves in downstream and B moves in upstream, then in how much time they will meet each other?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between two boats A and B: 272 km

Speed of boat A in still water: 32 km/h

Speed of boat B in still water: 36 km/h

**Concept:**

Relative speed of two objects moving towards each other is the sum of their individual speeds.

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of the stream be a km/hr.

⇒ Speed of boat A in downstream = 32 + a.

⇒ Speed of boat B in downstream = 36 - a.

The boats are moving towards each other,

So their relative speed is 32 + 36 + a - a = 68 km/h.

⇒ Time = Distance/Speed

⇒ Time = 272 km/68 km/h = 4 hours.

**Therefore, the two boats will meet each other after 4 hours.**

**Therefore, the actual profit percentage of the seller is 50%.**
